mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SF_INCIDENT (TITLE, DISASTER_TYPE, SEVERITY, STATUS, REGION, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) VALUES (#{title}, #{disasterType}, #{severity}, 'RECEIVED', #{region}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SF_INCIDENT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT * FROM SF_INCIDENT WHERE REGION = #{region} AND STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SF_INCIDENT_LOG (INCIDENT_ID, PREV_STATUS, NEW_STATUS, MEMO, CHANGED_BY) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{prevStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newStatus}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{changedBy,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SF_INCIDENT WHERE DISASTER_TYPE = #{disasterType} AND STATUS != 'CLOSED' AND CREATED_AT >= SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{minutesAgo}, 'MINUTE')
